detail.longDescription: Hand a coding agent a project's full history and ask it to take over: complete delivery averaged 4.95%. Supply the correct requirements and it reaches 8.11%. Builds pass 96.40%, target tests 9.01%, so a green build tells you very little. ReqMemBench, six agent setups, 37 targets: https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.07307 If you want a person watching the next takeover, shell --read-only claude prints a browser link and password: https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Programming # DevOps
